local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local ready=false
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local hp=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 assert(hp>0,'Player died during final assassin fight')
 local a=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x1e703))
 if not a or not a:isValid() then return end
 if not ready then ready=true print('Final combat ready') end
 if Actor.isDead(a) then print('Final assassin dead') end
 local d=a.position-self.position
 local c=camera.getPosition()
 local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(util.vector3(c.x+d.x,c.y+d.y,c.z))
 local angle=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z)
 print(string.format('Final assassin aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(angle*5120+.5))),math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*5120+.5)))
 if math.abs(angle)<.06 then print('Final assassin facing') end
 if d:length()<90 then print('Final assassin in reach') end
 timer=timer+dt
 if timer>1 then timer=0 print('Final fight Player health='..hp..' assassin health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(a).current..' pos='..tostring(a.position)..' distance='..d:length()) end
end}}}}
